requirement_text: First request after idle p95 ≤ 30 s; waking state displayed
record_type: delayed-response browser test for the waking-state half of the requirement

implementation.text: Getting things ready. This can take a moment.

test.method: Intercept GET /api/auth/me and delay it by 6000 ms, load /app with an authenticated storageState, assert the waking message becomes visible within 5000 ms, then assert the loaded dashboard renders once the response completes.

verdict: PASS - the waking state renders while a delayed first account request is pending in five fresh-stack runs; the delayed-response UI half of QR4.2 is closed in-repo.
caveats: The ≤ 30 s cold-start p95 is an external Better Stack monitor sample on /health/ready and the web origin; this record does not replace that measurement and is not a substitute for a production cold-start sample.
The test simulates a slow response by delaying /api/auth/me in the browser. It proves the UI state machine and copy, not the duration of a real cold start.
The Better Stack check records status codes only (keyword matching is a paid tier), so the external monitor cannot itself assert the waking copy.
